reviewedRevision: 2739506 plus the rework in this commit
owner: owner-sky, then owner-sky2 after a session restart
independentProbes: The reviewer's own reaction-limited bot, reading only public state, cleared 1324 of 1344 sector runs across all 24 sectors at 30, 60 and 120 Hz with 0.25 s and 0.35 s delay (0.5 hits per run), and won 9 of 12 full 24-sector campaigns. Eleven blind policies, pointer sweep included, won 0 of 264 runs each on sectors 3-24; a park-and-track bot won 1 of 264. From random states, a 0.5 s reaction always leaves an escape from every strike zone. 16,000 swept-bullet trials had no miss; 20,000 impacts conserved momentum without energy gain; 475 trace snapshots matched across 30, 60 and 120 Hz; 200 fuzz runs (2.88 million steps, hostile dt and pointer values) broke no invariant.

findings.observation: Only 6 sectors and no select or continue. There are now 24 data-driven sectors (teaching 1-8, combination 9-16, mastery 17-24) with carrier, wasp and dread carriers, eight fire patterns, aimed lane, column, grid and cross strike zones and accurate bilingual lessons, plus a sector select and env.progress continue; broken and throwing stores clamp safely.

Hulls could interpenetrate by up to 2 px and stay stuck. A whole-hull minimum-axis separation split by inverse mass now follows the impulse solver; the round-1 repro, 3000 random two-body runs and 144 in-game ramming runs show no overlap, and the pilot never leaves the play area.

Added tests/sky-raiders-quality.test.js: reaction-limited clears, blind-policy and park-and-track bounds, trace determinism across frame rates, env.end payloads in EN and ZH, fuzz, the real InputState and touch path, and broken progress stores.

Parking in one lane and holding fire won every run. Strike zones aimed at the pilot's heading now punish a stationary lane; park-and-track wins at most 8% of any sector from sector 3, and parking at the top loses within 26 s.
Dead code removed (the charge pod now drops), the help text explains the W, + and K pods in EN and ZH, and the 1,476-line file is split into eleven modules of at most 371 lines.

openNotes: Crowded pile-ups of three bodies around a pilot pinned at a wall can leave up to 0.21 px of overlap for up to 0.8 s in synthetic tests (5 of 900); in-game ramming showed none.
The full suite takes about 4-5 minutes, above the few-minutes target.
The widest English HUD line is about 463 of 480 px, tight if the host font is wider than the reviewer's estimate.
Strike zones cause about half the hits a late-sector player takes; the reviewer judged them avoidable with a 0.5 s reaction.
The pointer only works in the sector select; flight uses keys or the touch buttons.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, Play again, the language switch and the touch buttons, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened sector 1 of 24 (Cloudbreak); held arrow and Space keys moved and fired the interceptor and the score rose.
English loss: left idle, incoming fire exhausted the shields and the loss screen explained it; Play again restarted sector 1 with the score reset.
Chinese: the idle run ended with the localized loss message (敌方炮火耗尽了护盾).

Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): real presses on the touch buttons moved the ship right, fired (heat rose) and spent an interception charge (3 to 2) whose ring expanded on screen.
The console showed no errors or warnings after a fresh load.
Not covered in the browser: a full sector win and the sector select, which appears only after a first clear; both are covered by the reviewer's bots and the quality tests.
